item.title: Washington AG Sues Kalshi, Aims To Make Prediction Market Pay Back ‘Illegal’ Losses
item.description: The state said Kalshi’s sports and non-sports markets both qualify as illegal gambling, but could it be exempt due to "contracts" carve-out?

item.title: Morning Consult Poll: Prediction Markets Are Gambling, Should Be States' Purview
item.description: Morning Consult poll says that sports event contracts are potentially harmful for youth, should be state-regulated.

item.title: Texas Lt. Gov. Calls On Legislators To Close Prediction Market ‘Loopholes’
item.description: Lt Gov. Dan Patrick says prediction markets 'circumvent Texas gambling prohibitions by allowing users to bet on elections and other events.'

item.title: Fanatics Gains FCM Status, Splash Sports Jumps In Pool As Introducing Broker
item.description: FCM status is a higher designation that allows the company to accept and hold customer margin rather than routing through another firm.

item.title: Who Is Victor Rocha?
item.description: Despite the sometimes aggressive facade, Rocha's passion drives him to defend tribal sovereignty and he's no dummy.

item.title: Report: Federal Investigators Met With Polymarket Over Possible Illegal Insider Trades
item.description: CNN reports the prosecutors are focusing on “lucrative trades,” including ones on the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: CME, A Partner To Both FanDuel And DraftKings, Reverses Course On Political Event Contracts
item.description: CME CEO Terry Duffy last year said political event contracts were not a "good thing." CME also certified baseball and basketball parlays.

item.title: Mission Accomplished: IGA Mobilizes Indian Country Against Prediction Markets
item.description: At an annual conference that seemed more a rally against prediction markets, IGA leaders prepared Indian Country for the fight of its life.

item.title: Missouri Sports Betting Revenue Drops Again As Post-Chiefs Hangover Deepens
item.description: The Missouri Gaming Commission reports statewide sports betting revenue amounted to $30.4 million in February.

item.title: Six Months After Declaring Victory, Robinhood Is Falling Behind In Prediction Market Race
item.description: Robinhood’s share of volume on Kalshi fell from almost 60% in September to less than 23% in the first 27 days of March.
